axes.name: array_declaration
axes.rationale: The target uses a 64-byte row stride; compare linear and two-dimensional declarations of the same near byte storage.

axes.name: index_expression
axes.rationale: For coordinates accepted by IsValidA, x*64+y and (x<<6)+y denote the same byte; compare equivalent index representations and a register-lifetime snapshot.
values: if (IsValidA(x, y) == 1) ((unsigned char near *)MapA)[x * 64 + y] = value;
if (IsValidA(x, y) == 1) ((unsigned char near *)MapA)[(x << 6) + y] = value;

int column = x; int row = y;
    if (IsValidA(column, row) == 1) ((unsigned char near *)MapA)[(column << 6) + row] = value;
